scope: paired comparison on the same 40 synthetic challenge cases and 40 synthetic clean controls
limitations: Author expected labels are not clinician adjudication.
No verification is treated as pass-through with no review flags.
Verdict flip means any change among supported, unsupported, and uncertain across repetitions; deterministic-only flags are stable by design.
paired_judge_sampling_note: The standalone judge result is reused when the production full verifier reaches its entailment layer, so judge-only and full-verifier conditions share the same model verdict per case and repeat.
binary_scoring_rule: A case passes only if its verifier verdict is supported and no review flags are present. Unsupported, unresolved, or error outcomes count as failed (fail closed).
